violated_contract: A derived read cache identity must advance for every successfully committed source mutation, including an automatic retry of a successful Commit whose acknowledgement was lost. A request UUID generated outside GAPIC retry is not a commit revision: A can succeed, a reader caches A, B deletes another document, then A's retry restores its old UUID and the deleted document reappears from cache. A repeated source Increment without B also changes source data while retaining that UUID.
canonical_prevention: Atomically increment a server generation in the same head Write as source mutations; key raw projections by generation, request token and exact server update_time. Reject missing, malformed or saturated generations and old schema/coverage epochs. Require the same retry-safe capability from dependent head writers before reusing their projections; otherwise retain source paths. Preserve authorization and deletion fences.
